# Imdb API

> Reverse-engineered internal API. Unofficial — may change without notice.

## Documentation Index
- `SKILL.md` (this file)
- `references/REFERENCE.md` (detailed endpoint docs)
- `references/ENDPOINTS.json` (machine-readable endpoint catalog)
- `scripts/api.ts` (typed client interface)

## Authentication
Session Token (x-amzn-sessionid) — Authentication method detected from captured traffic.

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

## Dependencies
- Runtime capable of HTTPS requests.
- If using `scripts/api.ts`: TypeScript toolchain (or transpile to JS).

## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `GET /{id}/batch/{batchId}/op/{opToken}` — Complete authentication flow.

### Data Read (12)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve data by ID.
- `GET /{id}/{id}` — Retrieve data by two IDs.
- `GET /adx/user/sync` — Synchronize user data.
- `GET /api/ad/union/gg_cookie_matching` — Match Google cookies for ad targeting.
- `GET /api/sync` — Synchronize data.
- `GET /hbid/imp` — Get header bidding impression data.
- `GET /script/bundle` — Retrieve a script bundle.
- `GET /v1.0/parent/{parentId}/engagement/trigger/user_sync` — Trigger user sync for engagement.
- `GET /v1/{v1Id}` — Retrieve data by ID.
- `GET /v1/api/sync/openx` — Synchronize data with OpenX.
- `GET /v1/p/{pId}/classification` — Get classification for a specific item.
- `GET /websites/{websiteId}/v1/thu/{thuId}/desktop/chrome/other` — Retrieve data for a website.

### Data Write (4)
- `POST /{id}` — Create or update data.
- `POST /{id}/auction` — Submit a bid in an auction.
- `POST /{id}/batch/{batchId}/oe` — Submit data in a batch operation.
- `POST /v1.0/parent/{parentId}/engagement/trigger/{id}` — Trigger an engagement event.

### Media (1)
- `GET /film/{filmId}/poster/std/{stdId}` — Retrieve a film's poster image.

### Realtime (1)
- `POST /{id}/events/{id}.prod` — Subscribe to real-time updates for a specific production.

### Config (2)
- `GET /audience_segments/config.json` — Get audience segment configuration.
- `GET /cdn/prod/config` — Get CDN configuration.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Imdb's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Imdb data without official API access
- Automate actions on api.graphql.imdb.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Imdb frontend uses

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { ImdbClient } from "./scripts/api.ts";

// Load captured auth from auth.json
const client = await ImdbClient.fromAuthFile("auth.json");

// Make requests to internal endpoints
const result = await client.get("/endpoint");
```

- **Auth headers:** 2 (sec-fetch-storage-access, x-amzn-sessionid)
